$comment: Static model profiles: published capability/cost/speed characteristics per provider/model, as of Aug 2026. This is the PRIOR the learning loop (config/aihub.json 'learning') refines with observed outcomes — the catalog says what a model SHOULD be good at; recorded outcomes say what it HAS BEEN good at in this codebase. Update prices/context windows when providers change them; this file has no secrets.

models.note: Free tier rate-limited per GitHub plan; treat as $0 with a request cap, not truly free at scale.

selectionPolicy.$comment: How helios-ai/MCP pick a model when the caller specifies constraints instead of a provider. See docs/architecture/LLM_STRENGTHS_PLAYBOOK.md 'Cost & latency ladder'.
selectionPolicy.costSensitive: prefer the lowest inputPerMillionUsd+outputPerMillionUsd among models whose strengths include the task type
selectionPolicy.latencySensitive: prefer relativeSpeed fast > medium > slow, breaking ties by cost
selectionPolicy.qualitySensitive: prefer class frontier > balanced > specialist > fast, breaking ties by learned success rate
selectionPolicy.default: use the config/aihub.json routing chain; the catalog only applies when a request sets an explicit cost/latency/quality preference
